newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold closes down on global trends, silver up.
newsitem.headline: India gold closes down on global trends, silver up.

text.p: Gold 24 carat closed 15 rupees lower at 4,515 rupees per 10 gramme against the previous close of 4,530 rupees as losses in the world market triggered fresh selling, dealers said.
Arrivals remained slow during the day but sluggish physical buying aided the subdued sentiments.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.64 gramme) closed 200 rupees lower at 52,800 rupees per piece. They were steady on Monday after losing 200 rupees last week.
Premiums of import licence for bullion in India rose to 13.10/13.15 percent from 12.90/13.00 percent.
Silver (.999) closed 30 rupees higher at 6,430 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,400 rupees on the back of a rally in the world market coupled with renewed seasonal support.

Silver prices in early trade were subdued on unloading by local stockists but later on rising world prices dragged local prices upward towards the close. Silver was up by 30 rupees per kg on Monday after gaining 75 rupees last week.
